snippet.title: Märchen Line - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
PLAY NOW FREE: https://nthcircle.itch.io/marchenline

Created entirely in the month of September 2024 for VNSpooktoberJam, Märchen Line is a Dystopian Far-Future Military Dating Sim. 

Train your stats, build your relationships, and be all you can be...or push past the galactic narrative and seek a deeper understanding of humanity's true ranking in the galactic hierarchy.
